hypothesis: Training-only inverse-square-root emotion-frequency weights may improve rare-emotion recall
early_stop: Maximum development macro F1, patience six
training_targets: All original human soft vote distributions; no machine labels
weight_source: Training split vote frequencies only; normalize expected training weight to one
comparison: Existing all-clip unweighted fine-tunes on identical development speakers; report macro F1, each emotion recall and Brier score
test_policy: No old English test or Italian diagnostic evaluation in this experiment
calibration_caveat: Class weighting changes the optimized distribution; improved macro F1 alone cannot establish calibrated probabilities
device_policy: Tiny CPU can overlap the separate GPU audio teacher; queue other heavy GPU training
